Columns from not-wall density in the top row band; row y-extents from a per-row BRIGHTNESS profile down a clean column (lintel/glass/sill structure). Verified on 2x flat-texture crops. Storefront top (y0.205) and awning band (yWall 0.235 / yValance 0.18) measured by dark-fraction-per-row — the storefront is the corner half only (x0.50-1.0); the painted scalloped awning projects via the awnings component. Greenpoint face is the camera-visible frontage; the franklin return is a flat texture slice. Corner fix: the Greenpoint frontage is two collinear footprint edges (1.47m + 19.95m); sceneFrame.js now merges collinear same-role edges so the full 21.42m frontage textures as one face (was: the 1.47m corner off-cut rendered as a bare brown wall).
